notes: Modified cash basis city (governmental activities modified cash; business-type accrual), FY ended 9/30/2025. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement (p5) total column; beginning cash = beginning total fund balances, ending cash = total governmental funds assets (cash + CDs + county treasurer cash). Business-type receipts = Sales 589,010 (no nonoperating revenue); disbursements include operating expenses (incl. depreciation 130,043) and nonoperating expenses (loss on disposal, interest, bond fees); no printed single total, so disbursement total computed 637,445 + 86,386. Business-type roll-forward: 3,600,987 + 589,010 - 723,831 = 3,466,166. Business-type 2,500,000 debt proceeds appear only in cash flow/budget schedule (not in accrual net position statement). Cash flow statement: operating section used (116,890), reconciliation section prints 155,040 (see discrepancy). Detail: General Fund departmental combining schedule (pp11-12) recorded fully (Salaries and benefits mapped to salaries and wages; Transportation to dues, training and travel; Landfill mapped to public works; Cemetery to environment and leisure per function tie-out; Fire/Park capital outlay lines as capital outlay function, so Public safety function ties to statement 128,452). The all-funds budgetary comparison (p9) governmental lines are not recorded to avoid double counting with statements; only its business-type outflows (budget vs actual) and the business-type Bond anticipation note proceeds 2,500,000 (other financing) are in detail. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total column. Transfer cross-check: no transfers printed. Read pages 1-12 of 12 Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p5, p7) added for the funds that had no schedule. The combined business-type lines from the all-funds budgetary comparison schedule (did not tie to the proprietary statement) are replaced by the proprietary statement's Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns.
